title: Age of Empires
prompt: Build Age of Empires as a multi-file web real-time strategy game spanning the ancient world. Run FOUR resources — food, wood, gold and stone — and make villagers gather each from a physically distinct source with different rates and different drop-off buildings: foraging bushes, hunting animals that must be killed and then butchered before they rot, fishing from boats, farms that exhaust and must be rebuilt, chopping trees that are removed from the map, mining gold and stone veins that run out. The structural spine is AGE ADVANCEMENT: Stone, Tool, Bronze and Iron Age, each researched at the town centre for a large resource cost and each gated behind owning a required number of buildings from the previous age, unlocking whole tiers of units, buildings and upgrades on arrival. Houses cap population so expansion is mandatory. Add walls and towers that can be built anywhere, priests that convert enemy units over a channel time, siege weapons, and a naval tier. Give several civilisations meaningfully different bonuses and tech availability rather than palette swaps. The AI must gather with real villagers, advance ages on its own and attack in waves. Include a Wonder that can be built as an alternative victory condition, taking a long, loudly telegraphed time to complete.
